name: Framesurfer
original_description:
Framesurfer makes AI media from a description, right in the chat.

Pictures: make an AI picture from words, or change a picture Framesurfer made or one the user attaches. Pictures are saved in the user's Framesurfer library, ready to turn into a video clip.

Video clips: make a short video clip of a single shot, with sound, from words or starting from a picture.

Music: make an instrumental music track.

Framesurfer returns a link to each finished file. It asks before every generation step and runs it only after the user agrees. It requires a Framesurfer account.

For creators, marketers and small businesses who want visuals, clips and music for social media, ads and presentations.

Limitations: one video clip is made at a time per account; clips are short single shots; Framesurfer does not post to social platforms; and it does not depict real people without their consent.
